agreed to be acquired by Sequence Holdings and the DFO Management (Dell family office) in an all-cash deal valued at approximately $7.7B.
The shareholders will receive $32.50 per share, an approximately 88% premium to the unaffected June 17, 2026, closing price.
The deal includes approximately $4.6B in equity value and $3.1B of net debt assumed or refinanced, valuing Baldwin at about 20x trailing-twelve-month adjusted EBITDA of $396M.
The transaction is expected to close in Q1 2027, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals.
Moreover, eligible employees can roll over part of their equity and retain a minority stake in the private company.
Upon completion, the company will become privately held, and its shares will no longer trade on Nasdaq.
On the market side, the Baldwin stock traded nearly 7% higher at ~$31.65 in the pre-market session.

title: Baldwin Group stock soars on $7.7B take-private cash deal
